reason: Abstain instead of crashing on an unreadable path (#704): module-size 32689->32801 (+112), measured off d0970e8. Attributed EMPIRICALLY, never from the printed arrow: per #689/#703 the left operand of a check-arch verdict is baselines.json (26965, stale since 2026-08-10), so this branch prints 'REGRESSION: 32801 > 26965 (delta 5836)' while its actual contribution is 112. That the delta is a repo-wide artifact and not per-branch is directly observable right now -- unrelated PR #724 (history schema_version) prints delta 5779 off the same stale base. The real base was obtained in this worktree by restoring the three changed source files to origin/main, lifting the highest existing allowance (feat-459, 32689) so the verdict prints a currentValue at all, and re-running `harness check-arch --json`: 32689, exactly the feat-459 figure, so main has not moved since it was recorded. Restoring each file one at a time gives the split: ts/src/cli-commands.ts +83 (the sweepFiles/abstainOnUnreadable/reportSkips trio, ~40 lines of code and ~30 of comment), ts/src/core/gate-result.ts plus its generated npm/src/gate-result.ts mirror +34 (the shared errnoCode classifier, counted twice because sync-gate-result.mjs copies the engine file verbatim into the CommonJS package), and ts/src/core/promotion-verdict.ts -5, which SHRINKS because deleting its private ERRNO regex in favour of the shared helper removes more than the import adds. 83 + 34 - 5 = 112, and the parts sum to the whole, which is the check that the attribution is real rather than assumed. The growth is the fix: `review-test` and `flake-check` passed their path straight to StaticLinter, so readFileSync threw out of the command handler and printed a raw Node stack at exit 1 -- and exit 1 means 'I found findings' over a run that opened nothing, the denominator collapsed to zero. Both now take the shape scanVacuity/promotionVerdict already use, and a fault with no errno code still throws, because swallowing an unknown one is how a scanner learns to go quiet. Extraction into a new ts/src/core/ module was considered and rejected: module-size is a repo-wide aggregate, so N files summing to 83 score identically to one, and the trio is 40 lines of CLI-shaped code that reads the caller's json flag and calls the caller's abstain() -- moving it beside promotion-verdict.ts would buy nothing measurable and cost the locality that makes the three existing abstention guards in that file legible side by side. Nothing was absorbed here to avoid a fix. newViolations is 0 and totalViolations is 20, identical to origin/main measured in the same worktree; an earlier revision of this branch DID introduce 2 (complexity: functionLength=108 and nestingDepth=5, both in ts/test/abstention-longtail.test.ts, from a parametrised loop whose body held five inline test bodies) and those were fixed in code by hoisting each case to a module-scope helper and switching the loop to describe.each -- an allowance must never absorb a new violation. The 4 new test files' worth of cases (ts/test/abstention-longtail.test.ts, ts/test/gate-conformance.test.ts registry rows, ts/test/gate-result.test.ts errnoCode units, npm/scripts/__tests__/gate-result-mirror.test.js) are test code and module-size does not count them -- verified, since reverting only the source moved the metric the full 112.
